关键词: Acquisition by Beijing E-Town Dragon Semiconductor Industry Investment Center
主要内容: Mattson Technology, Inc. (MTSN) has completed its acquisition by Beijing E-Town Dragon Semiconductor Industry Investment Center. Under the terms of the merger agreement, Mattson stockholders will receive $3.80 per share in cash. As a result of the transaction, trading in Mattson common stock on the NASDAQ Global Select Market will cease. Mattson is a global semiconductor wafer processing equipment provider and a key supplier in the semiconductor industry. The acquisition marks a significant shift in the company's ownership and operations.
